description: Search the full Entra.news archive using natural language or keywords. Returns sourced excerpts from past issues with issue number, date, and URL. Supports hybrid semantic + keyword search (semantic requires OPENAI_API_KEY). Covers all Entra.news issues from mid-2023 to present.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10, max: 50)

mode.description: Search mode: hybrid (default), semantic-only, or keyword-only

query.description: Natural language question or keywords to search for

name: search_entra_news
